'''C-5D1''', also known as '''fifty one''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] who worked in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Belsavis prison|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war an Imperial-backed [[Invasion of Belsavis|mass breakout]] occurred in the prison, and one group of the [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] escapees known as the [[Blood of Talath]] began causing serious casualties among the prison guard as they appeared to pre-empt their attacks. [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Serik]], determined to discover how the Ratataki were communicating before attacks, sent C-5D1 with a Republic aligned individual into the [[Rattataki Battlewoods]] to analyze the sound there. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] discovered that the criminals were using bird calls to communicate.<ref name="TOR" />
